signals.summary: Apple announced 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with PROLED XDR touch displays and M5 Pro or M5 Max. Research whether a Netherlands-based creator should pay the substantial premium for the display, ports and pro-chip configuration instead of choosing the newly announced 14-inch M6 model or retaining an existing system.
facts: Apple Netherlands dates the announcement October 28, 2026 and says orders opened that day for November 6 availability.
Apple Netherlands lists the 14-inch M5 Pro family from EUR 3,349 including VAT.
Apple identifies tandem OLED, Touch, M5 Pro or M5 Max, Thunderbolt 5 and up to 24 hours of claimed battery life as family features.
signals.readerDecision: Should a Netherlands-based creator buy the 14-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR and M5 Pro for its touch tandem-OLED display, ports and pro workflow ceiling, or choose the lower-priced 14-inch M6 model or keep an existing laptop?

signals.summary: Apple Netherlands exposes an exact 14-inch M5 Pro order configuration alongside multiple M6 alternatives. Preserve the exact region and configuration while treating price and orderability as short-lived observations.
facts: The Dutch store lists a 14-inch M5 Pro configuration with 15-core CPU, 16-core GPU, 24 GB unified memory, 1 TB storage and standard glass.
The same Dutch store lists 14-inch M6 configurations with 16 GB, 24 GB or 32 GB memory and 1 TB storage.
Apple says the new models become available November 6, 2026.
